limits: Photographs and templates are previously seen development cases; template retrieval is not arbitrary 3D recovery.
No ground-truth depth or new physical Miller indices are measured.
No case ID, filename, old camera, hand annotation, or truth mesh selection enters inference.

synthetic.scope: synthetic closed-set unseen poses; seed fixed before evaluation; no parameter tuning on these renders

missing_template.scope: three removed-template checks; low silhouette errors do not reliably detect an absent template

publication_scope: aggregate measurements only; private source images and manual annotations are excluded
review: Independent code review; corrected input races, single-photo evidence, assisted-mode provenance, and compact-view axis state.

integration_checks.browser: two 611 photos -> 611 first candidate -> 20-face model; no console errors; photo input locked during inference
integration_checks.portable_packages: relocation, integrity, rebuild and eight-tool MCP passed
